notes.title: Version 1.0.3
notes.content:
A small patch coming in for players with HTC devices. Here are the following changes:
- HTC Vive "Cosmos" and "Focus" controllers now detected as "Standard" control scheme rather than "Vive Wand".
- Control layout can now be overridden on the "Gameplay" page of the settings menu (default is "Auto")

notes.title: Version 1.0.2
notes.content:
This patch brings fixes for those on non-English systems. Here are the following changes:

- Added capability to generate local log files using the "--logging" command line argument. Log files will save to "<install-directory>/Neon Cipher_Data/log".
- Fix for level file loading on non-English systems.
- Fix for subtitle speeds on non-English systems.

notes.title: Version 1.0
notes.content:
Our apologies that v0.1.6 was shipped. The following changes apply:

- "beta" removed from version field
- fixed player walk animation not playing sometimes when the player jumps onto a platform that is moving vertically.

Known issues:
- Level loading issues may persist with players who have non-English characters in there installation path. This is currently under investigation
